title: SameWorldTab
description: This Spigot plugin ensures that the Tab list only displays players who are in the same world as you.
body:
**SameWorldTab** is a lightweight and simple plugin that improves the tab list experience on your Minecraft server.

Instead of showing every online player, **SameWorldTab** only displays players who are in the same world as you. This keeps the tab list clean, relevant, and much easier to read—especially on servers with multiple worlds or game modes.

**Features**
Shows only players in the same world

Perfect for Multiverse and minigame servers

Lightweight and performance-friendly

Easy to use with no complex setup

**Compatibility**
Supports **Spigot & Paper**

Works with versions **1.20.1 – 1.21.11**

**Why use **SameWorldTab**?**
On larger servers, the tab list can quickly become cluttered and confusing. **SameWorldTab** ensures players only see who actually matters in their current world, creating a cleaner and more immersive experience.

Give your server a more organized feel with just one simple plugin.
